caption: Figure 2: Harness contract tax across sessions. The left group aggregates all 29 scanned sessions and the right group is the long-horizon session with the highest observed rate. A command counts as paying the tax when it carries a redundant cd prefix compensating for a silently lost working directory. The compensation is not marginal: 70.0 percent of all invocations and 98.8 percent of invocations in the longest session pay it, consuming 16.0 percent of all command characters.
